name: Talonhasp
description: Draw both claws up from the hips into a closed guard in one smooth motion with qi settled in the forearms.

name: Clawbase Scorer
description: Pull the claw through the target's guard arm while a thin stream of qi hardens the tips for the scoring cut.

name: Pirouetting Palmstrap
description: Step diagonally forward off the opponent's centerline with the claws raised so the next stroke has an open angle.

name: Nailbarrier
description: Seat the tines against the opponent's wrist and press steadily to hold the striking hand low.

name: Acrid Knucklespike
description: Answer a parried blow with a short return rake over the same arm before the opponent can pull it home.

name: Clawtip Slap
description: Push a sudden flare of qi down the forearm into the claws as the rake lands so the tips bite through a leather vambrace.

name: Lassoing Talon
description: Hook the wrist and turn the claw sharply so the qi-driven tines twist the grip open and strip the weapon away.

name: Gripping Raze
description: Set the tines on the point of the elbow and press inward so the arm folds and cannot swing wide.

name: Pawlbuckle
description: Hook beneath the wrist with the lower tines and lift it until the opponent's guard rises off the ribs.

name: Stalling Tinecurve
description: Sink both claws into one sleeve and pull the cloth taut across the arm to pin it against the chest.

name: Brutal Wristband
description: Rake the free claw down the forearm that the other hand holds pinned so the cut lands without a dodge.

name: Nailstalk
description: Let the bind go and slide sideways in the same moment so the opponent's counter strikes empty air.

name: Rooted Backplate
description: Lay the tines over an opposing hook punch and press it down and away before it can curl into the ribs.

name: Ripscreen
description: Hold the sunk tines locked in the opponent's sleeve while a steady flow of qi keeps the hooks from slipping free.

name: Cramping Clawrake
description: Drag the bound arm across the opponent's own body with a sudden qi-backed pull that spins him half around.

name: Flayflog
description: Set the blade edge square to the target and rake along its line so every tip bites at the same depth.

name: Rude Hookclaw
description: Scoop the claw upward beneath the opponent's forearm and into the underside of the chin or belly.

name: Shielding Backplate
description: Hold the claw slanted across the body so a thrust slides along the blade backs and off to one side.

name: Slinking Flay
description: Slide the rear foot up to the lead as the raking hand leads out so the advance and the stroke share one beat.

name: Vicious Raze
description: Charge the tips with qi before a long reaching rake that scores a line down the whole length of the arm.

name: Brisk Scour
description: Gather qi at the tine points and thrust straight in so the claws pierce the gap between armor plates.

name: Talonscreen
description: Hold the claws forward with the hooks turned in so a punch must pass the tines to reach the face.

name: Humnail
description: Beat the incoming forearm aside with the back of the claw and let the tines scrape it as it goes.

name: Claynail
description: Rake over the top of the opponent's extended arm to score the shoulder and neck while the arm is still out.

name: Rillraze
description: Draw the front foot back and lean away so a swinging blow misses by a hand's width.

name: Ember Fingerblade
description: Slip inside a swing and score the ribs with a short claw cut as the opponent passes.

name: Gall Rip
description: Hook the tips behind the opponent's guarding wrist and pull it open to expose the chest.

name: Haze Clawbase
description: Turn the blade back against a blow and rake out along the same line so the parry and the cut are one stroke.

name: Shredslap
description: Flare qi through the claw the moment a blow is turned and slash across the opponent's open flank.

name: Clawtip Buckle
description: Spin the hooked claw around the striking wrist and wrench it out of line so the counter blow never lands.

name: Guarding Tinecurve
description: Plant the feet shoulder wide and hold the clawed gauntlets before the chest so the stance can move in any direction.

name: Clay Shred
description: Swat the back of the gauntlet across the opponent's face so the blade ridges rake the cheekbone.

name: Humtalon
description: Slide the back of the claw along the opponent's forearm like a rail to steer the strike out of line.

name: Rill Knucklespike
description: Lunge forward from the rear leg with the claws leading so the opponent is pressed back a pace.

name: Stampflay
description: Drop the gauntlet onto the opponent's forearm and hook the tines in to hold it away from the body.

name: Ember Clawrake
description: Roll the wrist over as the claw sweeps so the tines drag along the arm in a long curving score.

name: Shard Talon
description: Close both gauntlets together before the face to take a flurry and step in once it slackens.

name: Hookclaw Flog
description: Let qi bloom through the gauntlet at the moment of impact so the claw ridges cut far deeper than the arm's weight.

name: Fierce Rip
description: Drive the qi-hardened tines into the seam of a breastplate and spread the gap with a quick twist.

name: Stalling Fingerblade
description: Catch the opposing wrist between the crossed gauntlets and wrench steadily until the joint gives and the weapon falls.

name: Talonlinen
description: Read the stitching of the opponent's jacket in a glance to find the line where a rake will part it.

name: Flayslap
description: Scratch the tips across a buckle strap again and again until the leather fibers begin to fray.

name: Discord Flay
description: Catch a loose fold of cloth on the tines and tear it away to bare the arm or snag the opponent's stride.

name: Hazenail
description: Angle the claw so a leather-clad blow glances off the hide plates of the forearm guard.

name: Brawn Scour
description: Step along the line of the opponent's shoulder seam so each rake can follow the stitching down.

name: Sleetpawl
description: Hook the tines through a belt buckle and haul back so the clasp pulls free and the armor gapes.

name: Comet Palmstrap
description: Draw a fine thread of qi into the tine points and push them through two layers of boiled leather.

name: Crimson Talon
description: Draw the qi-edged claw across the crossing straps of a harness and shear the whole rig from the shoulder.

name: Keen Shred
description: Rake the opponent's flank as you run past and keep going so the cut lands without a turn.

name: Veering Shred
description: Lope forward in long low strides with the claws trailing at the hips and ready to swing up.

name: Flaybuckle
description: Stop a run with one planted foot and hook the tines into the opponent's belt to arrest both of you.

name: Guarding Wristband
description: Weave the claws side to side while running so thrown blows are brushed away without breaking stride.

name: Ruthless Knucklespike
description: Spring from a stride and drop the raking claw onto the opponent's shoulder as the body comes down.

name: Fierce Wristband
description: Drive qi into the legs and arms together so a sprint carries two raking strokes through a defender's line.

name: Entangling Rip
description: Hold the hooked hand fast on the opponent's arm and skid around it so his own weight swings him off his feet.

name: Tinecurve Barrier
description: Hook the claw over the opponent's arm and drag it down so the body follows into reach.

name: Tethering Palmstrap
description: Rest the tines on the side of the neck without cutting and hold the head still by the threat alone.

name: Binding Scour
description: Hook the belt with the lead claw and turn the hips under the opponent to throw him over the thigh.

name: Honed Raze
description: Sweep the claw low across the opponent's ankle to take the footing as the other hand holds his arm.

name: Claytalon
description: Slip the claw inside an opponent's collar grip and lift the elbow so the choke cannot close on the throat.

name: Scudding Clawtip
description: Roll the shoulders away from a hold and let the hooked claw cut the grip as the body slides free.

name: Static Flay
description: Bite the tines into the opponent's jacket with a pulse of qi and throw him over the hip before the cloth tears.

name: Sleet Clawbase
description: Press the hooked claw into the elbow joint and push with steady qi until the arm locks straight and numb.

name: Rough Fingerblade
description: Rake the clawed hand along the floor beneath a fallen opponent and drag a leg out from under him.
